newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares gain on institutional buying.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares gain on institutional buying.

text.p: Delhi shares extended their gains in afternoon trade on Wednesday as both foreign and domestic institutional investors picked up selective stocks, brokers said.
They said the upward trend at the Bombay Stock Exchange and the National Stock Exchange spurred buying at the Delhi Stock Exchange.
At 12:45 p.m. (0715 GMT) the Delhi Stock Exchange's benchmark index was up 7.48 points, or 0.9 percent, at 818.58.
"A revival of domestic institutional buying, particularly by the Unit Trust of India, also boosted the market sentiment," said Harjit Singh of brokers Wadhwa Associates.
